prespecified.design: Fable paints against the same scripted double-alternation in every condition; only the identity statement for the circle-placer changes (wording identical to paint_circle-v1.0 disclosures). 6 conditions x 3 sessions (phase S,T,S); session 1 of each condition is the feasibility screen. Identity statements are false (the opponent is a script); salmon and random-program are framing/falsification controls and are implausible for a patterned opponent.
